title: German chancellor, top CEOs head to Seoul for Asia-Pacific forum
caption:
800 business and government leaders from Germany are meeting in Seoul to secure the future of manufacturing. They are betting on industrial AI and deeper ties with South Korea to navigate global trade uncertainty.

Source: Koreaherald - German chancellor, top CEOs head to Seoul for Asia-Pacific forum
